name: coding-agent-task-monitor
description: Run CATM on a NAS for durable author decisions and remote coding-agent control.

interface.shortDescription: NAS-hosted MCP decisions over Weixin and Feishu.
interface.longDescription: Runs one durable NAS-hosted MCP service for coding-agent sessions, author decisions, remote instructions, and completion notifications.
defaultPrompt: Deploy the CATM MCP service on my NAS with Docker Compose.
Connect Codex, Claude Code, and opencode to the remote CATM endpoint.
Bind my author identity on Weixin or Feishu.
Diagnose a CATM author decision that did not resume an agent.
